method: Model-generated paraphrases (about 20 per planner route, varied wording, typos, abbreviations and indirect phrasings), reviewed before commit. Never regenerated in CI. Consumed by ai/planner_eval_test.go (stub model: routing fidelity; deterministic baseline report) and ai/planner_live_eval_test.go (-tags irisplannereval: a real provider's routing accuracy).
